svg.font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 16 nodes and 25 edges. Flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: Ingress, Normalize, Deduplicate. Key relationships: Ingress points to Normalize; Ingress points to Deduplicate; Ingress points to Prioritize. Layout spans 895 by 1103 units with 16 rendered node boxes and 25 routed edge paths.
